pattern_alerts:
All verified from PostgreSQL this cycle (n shown per pattern):

1. TRAIL ARMING IS THE SEPARATOR (24h, n=20): trailing_activated=True → 11T 9W +0.88; False → 9T 0W -0.96. Every unarmed close lost money. Winning side = trades that reached +0.40% MFE before the 45m timeout. Why we weren't on it: the 9 unarmed entries either died in chop (MFE < 0.40) or timed out — direction was often right (4 of them were shorts in the winning direction).

2. DIRECTION (24h): SHORT 13T 8W +0.31 vs LONG 7T 1W -0.39. Aggregate says SHORT_BIAS and the money confirmed it. The single 24h long winner was AVAX +0.01 (flat). Winning side = short; we were on it 13/20 times and that's where all the profit came from.

3. 7d RSI BANDS vs PICK GUIDANCE (n=79 with meta_rsi): LONG bands — <45: 9T -0.21 | 45-55: 27T -0.82 | 55-65: 19T -0.98 | >65: 14T +0.56 (only positive). SHORT bands — <45: 13T +0.19 | 45-55: 8T -0.18 (worst) | 55-65: 4T +0.47 (best) | >65: 5T +0.17. The standing pick guidance "LONG at 45-60" sits inside the worst long band (-0.82 over 27 trades); "SHORT at 45-55" sits inside the worst short band. Winning side = longs entered OVERBOUGHT (>65) and shorts at 55-65 — i.e. momentum continuation, not mean reversion. Reporting only; parameter changes are brain-auditor territory.

4. volume-buildup- STEER IS STALE (n=10 24h): 6W 4L -0.04 net. All 4 losses closed 11:46-14:54 yesterday; 5 straight wins since 15:16 (+0.47). The automated "4-loss streak" steer describes a streak that ended ~16h ago — should be retired, not acted on.

5. LOSING-SHORT AUTOPSY (n=4: ALT -0.17, ME -0.11, ZRO -0.11, CC -0.15): MFE 0.22/0.07/0.23/0.26 — none reached the +0.40% arm. Same signal, same direction produced 6 winners the same day. Winning side for these four = the identical short entered where follow-through came (or held past arm); we were on the right side at the wrong chop point, which under pattern 1 is an arm/timeout problem, not a direction problem.
